0022600224.text: The Utah Jazz (1-10, 1-5 at home) host the Orlando Magic (3-7, 0-4 on the road... ) in the Jazz's 12th game of the 2026-27 season, with Utah on a nine-game losing streak and 15th in the West while Orlando sits 11th in the East, with a 3-3 road record and a one-game win streak. Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), Keyonte George (ankle sprain), and Lauri Markkanen (wrist sprain), while Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), and Tristan da Silva (calf strain). The teams have not met yet this season, and the Jazz lost both meetings in 2025-26, most recently a 120-117 defeat in Orlando on February 7, 2026.
